assessment.nobel_worthiness: Inflation and quantum-generated primordial structure supply the conceptual framework linking early-universe physics to the observed cosmos.
assessment.attribution: Guth initiated inflation, Linde developed its viable forms, and Mukhanov established the quantum origin of perturbations.
assessment.maturity: CMB anisotropies and large-scale structure strongly support core predictions, though they do not uniquely identify an inflationary microphysics.
uncertainties: The underlying inflationary mechanism and direct primordial-gravitational-wave test remain unsettled.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: BAO turned a relic of early-universe sound waves into a robust standard ruler for the expansion history.
assessment.attribution: These researchers led seminal detections and survey analyses that established BAO as a practical cosmological probe.
assessment.maturity: Repeated measurements across surveys and redshifts make the effect exceptionally well confirmed.
uncertainties: Credit must distinguish the underlying theoretical prediction from the observational demonstrations.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: WMAP made precision cosmology operational by mapping the microwave background with transformative accuracy.
assessment.attribution: Bennett, Spergel, and Page represent mission leadership, cosmological interpretation, and experimental realization.
assessment.maturity: Its principal results were extensively checked and extended by subsequent CMB measurements.
uncertainties: A mission-scale achievement has broader collaboration credit than three individuals can capture.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The Aharonov-Bohm effect and geometric phase exposed the physical significance of quantum phase and topology across physics.
assessment.attribution: Aharonov is central to the nonlocal phase effect, while Berry formulated the broadly influential adiabatic geometric phase.
assessment.maturity: Both phenomena are experimentally established and have proved foundational over decades.
uncertainties: The two effects are distinct enough that their combination requires a carefully articulated common citation.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: IceCube's high-energy neutrinos created a new observational channel on the violent universe.
assessment.attribution: Halzen was a decisive scientific leader in conceiving and advancing the IceCube programme.
assessment.maturity: The astrophysical neutrino flux and source associations establish the field, though source-by-source astronomy is still developing.
uncertainties: The achievement rests on a very large collaboration, making individual attribution difficult.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Afterglow observations established gamma-ray bursts as distant cosmological explosions and opened their detailed study.
assessment.attribution: Costa and Frontera were central to the BeppoSAX breakthrough, while Kulkarni made pivotal optical follow-up identifications.
assessment.maturity: The cosmological origin and afterglow framework are now firmly established.
uncertainties: The precise division of priority among satellite teams and follow-up observers needs careful historical review.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: High-gain X-ray free-electron lasers furnished an extraordinary new instrument for probing matter on ultrafast atomic scales.
assessment.attribution: Kim provided key theory, while Pellegrini and Rossbach were major figures in translating the concept into operating facilities.
assessment.maturity: The technology is mature and has delivered a broad body of scientific results.
uncertainties: The achievement combines foundational theory, accelerator engineering, and many-facility collaboration.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Optical lattice clocks have advanced timekeeping and precision tests to a qualitatively new level.
assessment.attribution: Katori introduced the magic-wavelength lattice-clock concept and Ye made leading experimental realizations and advances.
assessment.maturity: Independent laboratories have demonstrated exceptional performance and compelling applications.
uncertainties: Its eventual fundamental impact may depend on future geodesy and tests of physics beyond current demonstrations.
